source.name: Tanzil Quran metadata (classification and revelation order)

period.heading: Period of Revelation
period.text: The internal evidence of the style shows that the period of the revelation of this Surah is probably the middle Makkan period, and especially that part of it, when antagonism had grown quite strong and every sort of mischief was being adopted to frustrate the mission of the Holy Prophet.

source.name: Sayyid Abul A'la Mawdudi, Tafhim al-Qur'an (introduction to the surah)

theme.heading: Subject Matter and Theme
theme.text: The discourse is meant to warn and reprove the people of Makkah and their chiefs for their antagonistic attitude that they had then adopted towards the Holy Prophet's message of Tauhid, like a well wisher, and also to admonish them like a teacher, as if to say: "O foolish people, the way to which this Prophet is calling you is to your own advantage.

source.name: Sayyid Abul A'la Mawdudi, Tafhim al-Qur'an (introduction to the surah)
